dependency_scope: ldd-resolved ELF bytes observed inside recorded derived build image; not exhaustive runtime loading

execution_budget.precedence: Hard global resource caps in addition to per-operation SLOs; their maxima are not additive allowances. Exhaustion leaves coverage incomplete and cannot pass or be reported as a measured backend SLO result.

managed_restore.canonical_location: A fixed-canonical-URI restore must be labelled as such and cannot substitute for relocated graph-root checks. No cluster-location adoption, metadata rewrite, symlink or original-tree fallback. Any unmet required restore boundary remains blocked.
managed_restore.contract: independent storage with originals unavailable; preserve exact cluster identity, graph pins and native closure
managed_restore.effect_replay: No replay or new identity for an unknown native operation; ownership transfer only after qualified quiescence.

not_admitted: normal Writfold writer or owner services
managed-root adoption at a new location

resources.operator_preflight: qualification/resources.json and actual ci-infra storage binding, unchanged

development_contract.storage: fresh disposable local-Linux cluster; one supervised native writer, no external providers or cloud stores
development_contract.transport: authenticated loopback HTTP 0.14; fixed named queries; conditional mutation route only after obtaining an exact pin

workloads.budget_policy: Frozen before measurement. A failure is retained and cannot be turned into a pass by post-hoc threshold changes.
workloads.cold_definition: fresh server process, OS page cache explicitly uncontrolled; no host-cache dropping or hardware-cold claim
workloads.discovery: bounded typed-relationship candidate discovery only; lexical/fuzzy/vector search is unqualified and not advertised
workloads.trace_policy: All native warnings/errors and every complete client request/response are retained; per-read native INFO telemetry is disabled before workload measurement.

member_provenance: Built from pinned source; observed hashes in source build receipt
scope: Exact source development qualification contract; no public alpha, production backend or WF24 admission
server_version_note: Actual --version and --help results retained in producer.json; no inferred server-reported version
